ov: The largest mammalian carnivore on Madagascar: a slender, cat-like hunter with a tail nearly as long as its body. Its closest relatives are mongooses, and flexible ankles let it climb up and down trees head-first. It hunts by both day and night.
rg: Forests throughout Madagascar, from western dry forests to eastern rainforests and southern spiny forests.
df: Lemurs make up over half its diet, plus tenrecs, rodents, lizards and birds.
fx: It is feared by many Malagasy people and is often protected by a fady (taboo).
It can live 20 years or more in captivity.
